content.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.

content.summary: Small-cap stocks in the Russell 2000 (^RUT) can be a goldmine for investors looking beyond the usual large-cap names. But with less stability and fewer resources than their bigger counterparts, these companies face steeper challenges in scaling their businesses.

content.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after the major indices continued to pull back, with technology stocks accounting for most of the market's largest decliners. content.title: WNC Q2 Deep Dive: Demand Weakness Drives Guidance Cut, Parts and Services Outperform
content.summary: Semi trailers and liquid transportation container manufacturer Wabash (NYSE:WNC) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2025, but sales fell by 16.7% year on year to $458.8 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $1.6 billion at the midpoint came in 6.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.15 per share was 55.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
